intro: The 2027 conference follows the APRU-SCL format: three days of keynotes, thematic sessions, and collaborative working groups, framed by a pre-conference student symposium and field visits across Singapore. The outline below is what to expect. Session-level detail and the full schedule will be published as they are confirmed.

blocks.title: Keynotes
blocks.summary: Plenary addresses from leading voices in sustainable cities and landscapes across the Pacific Rim, framing the conference theme for the full assembly.

blocks.title: Thematic sessions
blocks.summary: Paper, poster, and panel sessions grouped by theme, drawn from the open call for abstracts. Sessions examine solutions and challenges in urban and environmental sustainability through transdisciplinary collaboration, comparative studies, and cross-cultural investigation.

blocks.title: Working groups
blocks.summary: Eleven ongoing thematic groups meet across the conference to build joint agendas rather than present static papers, each aiming to leave Singapore with a planned output. The full roster is confirmed and listed below.

blocks.title: Student symposium
blocks.summary: A pre-conference symposium for graduate and doctoral students to present work, meet peers from across the network, and take part in the conference that follows.

blocks.title: Field visits
blocks.summary: Guided visits to sites across Singapore, using the city's density, land scarcity, and institutional structure as a live case for the conference theme.

scheduleNote: The detailed program will be updated as sessions are confirmed. Register your interest to be notified when the schedule is published.
